name: io.github.alexlivre/minimax-image-mcp
title: MiniMax Image Generation
description: Generate images with MiniMax image-01: batches, exact dimensions, and character references.

environmentVariables.name: MINIMAX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the MiniMax API

environmentVariables.name: MINIMAX_ALLOWED_OUTPUT_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional delimiter-separated allowlist of directories where images may be written

environmentVariables.name: MINIMAX_ALLOWED_REFERENCE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional delimiter-separated allowlist of directories from which reference images may be read

environmentVariables.name: MINIMAX_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum automatic retries for transient errors (default: 3)
